# Alexander T. Bell (Alec Bell)

> Personal site of Alec Bell: co-founder and CTO of ThunderPhone, which builds AI voice agents that handle real phone calls for businesses. Previously solo founder of SensorSurf (YC W23, robot-fleet data infrastructure); earlier worked on self-driving cars at Uber ATG, conversational AI at Expedia, and autonomous marine systems at Sea Machines. MS in computer science (CU Boulder, computer-vision research published at ECCV 2022), BS from Ohio State. Based in San Francisco.

## Pages

- [Home](https://alexandertbell.com/): about, current work, photos
- [Background](https://alexandertbell.com/background): job history, education, publications
- [Blog](https://alexandertbell.com/blog): occasional writing
